text:
mike: alert - multiple runtime containers in us-west-2 are crashing, node flaps + CUDA memory errors. Autoscaler kicked but pods keep restarting. seeing OOM + cudaMalloc failures in logs. impacts some hosted customers  — high 5xx rate.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: #12378 - us-west-2 runtime instability (automated detection). paging on-call.
mike: stack: paged-attn allocator memory usage trending up for ~36h, slow creep. KV cache hit rate dropping, evictions spiking.
anita: taking initial triage. can you dump recent logs + nvml output? which pool is this (hosted/dedicated)?
mike: hosted inference pool rwd-hosted-usw2-gpu. attaching quick logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T02:14:10Z] runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (dst=0x7f8a1234)
[2026-03-15T02:14:10Z] runtime: OOM killer invoked for pid 2345 (inference-runtime)
[2026-03-15T02:14:11Z] runtime: container restart (exit code 137)
[2026-03-15T02:14:12Z] allocator: paged-attn: resident_pages=842MB -> 1.9GB over 36h
[2026-03-15T02:14:12Z] kvcache: pages_in_use=452k, fragmentation_ratio=0.62
```
raj: that's classic paged-attn+kv slow-leak pattern. fragmentation slowly increases -> less contiguous allocs -> cudaMalloc fails. we've seen this before with long-running prefix-heavy workloads.
sophia: customer impact check: telemetry shows 3 tenants with >=30% request failures in last 10m (tenant ids redacted). SLO windows likely breached for those.
carla: can we evict cold prefixes more aggressively? what's current kv eviction threshold?
mike: eviction_age=48h, maybe too high for these customers. also auto-batching holding onto KV caches for long-running chat sessions.
anita: immediate mitigation plan: 1) lower eviction_age to 6h for hosted pool; 2) increase compaction frequency for paged-attn slab; 3) enable fallback routing to smaller model-quantized variant for affected routes; 4) cordon/flap the most noisy node if it keeps failing.
sre-lead: +1. also open a straight-through fallback policy so requests don't queue behind failing nodes. notify support to customer-ops.
raj: quick commands:
```
# set eviction_age on pool
redwoodctl pools update rwd-hosted-usw2-gpu --kv-eviction-age=6h
# force compaction job
redwoodctl runtime jobs trigger --job=kv-compact --pool=rwd-hosted-usw2-gpu
```
anita: running update now. will monitor.
anita: deploy-bot: applied kv eviction config change to rwd-hosted-usw2-gpu (cfg rev 1245).
deploy-bot: CONFIG UPDATE: kv-eviction-age -> 6h applied by anita to rwd-hosted-usw2-gpu at 2026-03-15T02:18:05Z.
mike: starting compaction job. compaction logs show slab sweep started.
raj: also temporarily lowering batch size for that pool to reduce memory pressure (will increase latency a bit).
anita: lowered batch_max_tokens -> 256 for rwd-hosted-usw2-gpu.
sophia: customer-ops notified: message sent to affected tenants; we're tracking degraded performance and mitigation steps.
carla: after compaction finished, one node still crashed once then stabilized. overall 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 4% in 8m after changes.
mike: good. still want full root-cause. schedule postmortem and slas. assign follow-ups:
- raj: perf-level allocator telemetry add'l graphs + triggers (action item)
- eng-runtime: investigate fragmentation root cause + long-term compaction strategy
- product/support: customer impact summary + outreach
sre-lead: oncall handoff: i'm taking this for the next hour to follow escalation and liaise with customers. anita, mike, raj - please add notes to the incident doc and mark any remaining nodes to drain if they show further flaps.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: severity -> SEV2, assigned -> sre-lead.
mike: closing thread here for live triage; will keep updates in incident doc. follow-up postmortem scheduled. :white_check_mark:
